Which 10 tools does the Ansible MCP server discover?

answer_card.title: Ansible MCP server tools
answer_card.answer_md:
Ask Copilot *What Ansible tools are available through the MCP server?* (runs `list_available_tools`). The tools are:

- `zen_of_ansible`
- `ansible_content_best_practices`
- `list_available_tools`
- `ansible_lint`
- `ansible_navigator`
- `ade_environment_info`
- `ade_setup_environment`
- `adt_check_env`
- `create_ansible_projects`
- `define_and_build_execution_env`
